title: Synthetic training organisation security policy
text: The proposed software shall authenticate staff before exposing restricted loan application information.
applicability: Demonstration project only; not a law, regulation or approved institutional policy.

title: Synthetic training organisation security policy
text: The proposed software shall enforce role-based access for staff and privileged administrators.
applicability: Demonstration project only; not a law, regulation or approved institutional policy.

title: Synthetic training organisation security policy
text: The proposed software shall record staff changes and approval decisions in an audit trail with actor and timestamp.
applicability: Demonstration project only; not a law, regulation or approved institutional policy.
